messages:
ana: paging eng-oncall — canary deploy of inference-runtime v2.3.1 in eu-west-1 is spiking with KMS decrypt errors, model loads failing. customers hitting the canary are getting 500s. rolling back?

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-379001 — high error rate on canary. Alert: 30% 5xx for /v1/models/load in eu-west-1-canary. Triggered at 2026-02-28T09:12:00Z.

dylan_oncall: on it. can you drop the last error lines from pod logs? also which deploy job kicked this off?

ana: here's tail from pod (truncated):

```
2026-02-28T09:11:57Z ERROR inference-runtime Failed to decrypt model key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-inference-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-NEWKEY-ef01
    at com.amazonaws.services.kms.model.AccessDeniedException
Caused by: KMSException: key not found for alias 'alias/model-key'
```

jia: that AccessDenied looks like a permissions/mismatch to me. we rotated keys last night (rotation for alias 'alias/model-key') — but i thought the deploy pipeline read the managed secret id. could be the canary image baked with the old KMS key id in env.

mohit: rolling back canary now (reverting to v2.3.0). executing: `deploy-bot rollback canary eu-west-1 inference-runtime --to v2.3.0`

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started by mohit. Canary rollback in progress.

dylan_oncall: good. also please run `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id abcd-NEWKEY-ef01` and `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` to confirm role perms. if AccessDenied is due to policy we need to patch KMS key policy or IAM role.

kerri: quick heads-up — customer telemetry flagged 12 unique orgs with elevated errors (5xx) between 09:11-09:18 UTC. severity: P2 given partial region impact but customer-facing. notifying support to prepare comms.

mohit: rollback complete, canary stopped, traffic reverted to v2.3.0. error rate across region back to baseline. confirming logs show fewer decrypt failures.

sre-bot: monitor: 5xx drop from 30% -> 2% within 4 minutes after rollback.

ana: thanks — while rolling back i checked the deploy job env: the canary image had KMS_KEY_ID set to `abcd-OLDKEY-1234` which no longer exists. pipeline should have substituted alias but appears to have been replaced with hard key id at build time.

dylan_oncall: ok this is a classic rotate+deploy race. we need to: 1) ensure the runtime can fallback to alias lookup, 2) update deploy pipeline to always use `alias/model-key` not raw id, 3) patch IAM/KMS so minimum downtime for next rotation.

jia: i just ran `aws kms describe-key --key-id abcd-NEWKEY-ef01` — key exists but key policy only allows `kms:Decrypt` for a specific service principal; the role used by the inference instances (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference-role) wasn't added to the key policy during rotation. looks like the rotation playbook missed adding the role.

mohit: adding a quick temporary grant via CLI to restore access while we fix rotation automation. command: 

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id abcd-NEWKEY-ef01 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference-role --operations Decrypt
```

apply now?

dylan_oncall: yes apply. but be sure to add a TTL or record grant id so rotation cleans it. also update key policy in parallel so grant isn't the only thing.

kerri: support update: we informed affected customers that we detected a config issue during a canary rollout and have routed traffic away. no widespread data loss, some requests errored. comms queued.

sre-bot: create ticket: SVC-2026-379001 — deploy pipeline wrote static KMS key ids during build. assign to eng-platform.

jia: grant applied. verifying: logs show successful decrypts on new test pods. i'll keep watch.

mohit: patched rotation script to add the inference role to the new key policy and emit the alias for the deploy pipeline. pushing change to infra repo now.

dylan_oncall: thanks. next steps: - root cause: rotation run created new key but playbook didn't add role to key policy AND the build system baked raw key id into canary image. - immediate mitigation: rollback canary (done), temporary grant (done), support comms (ongoing). - remediation: change rotation playbook to update key policies + modify pipeline to resolve alias at deploy time (not bake key id).

ana: putting a feature-flag kill-switch on for the new runtime rollout globally until we validate rotation fixes. feature-flag CMD: `ffctl set inference-runtime-v2 global off --by ana`

sre-bot: feature flag toggled by ana — inference-runtime-v2 set to OFF for all traffic.

kerri: handing off to day on-call @dylan for follow-up and postmortem write-up. i'll update the incident channel once comms are sent.

dylan_oncall: i'll own the postmortem. initial action items: (1) eng-platform to patch build pipeline (2) infra to harden rotation playbook (3) add unit test to CI to ensure builds don't contain literal KMS key ids. please ack.

jia: ack — creating PRs now.

mohit: ack — will coordinate key policy changes and run a canary rotation in a sandbox.

kerri: ack. support will send a follow-up status in 2 hours.

dylan_oncall: closing incident thread here — monitoring for 1 hour then will file full incident report. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
